stem: How did industrialization in the 1800s affect life in the United States?

options.label: A
options.text: It led to an increased reliance on imported goods.

options.label: B
options.text: It led to increased isolationist views about conflicts in other countries.

options.label: C
options.text: It led to nativist feelings against the growing immigrant population.

options.label: D
options.text: It led to concerns about the growing population of enslaved people.
